MODEL REVIEW (claude-opus-5-5, a model and not a human, 2026-11-05; reviewed_by stays null): BLOCKED retained after re-evaluation for the isolated simulator host (SDK change SIM-HOST). The host now owns a lifecycle and contains exits, but the route also needs an independent, acknowledged simulator stop with a state read-back, and the clone has none. The UTMRS simulator (submodule submodules/ut_multirobot_sim, gitlink b724b60d) offers only two services, utmrsStepper and utmrsReset (src/simulator/simulator_main.cpp:248-251); in its default service mode (:63-64) the main loop is ros::spin() (:259-263) and the world advances only inside StepService (:182-208); sim_start_stop is a topic that toggles a state only the non-service loop reads (:67-75, 264-290), and sim_state is published only there (:283-286). The only stop is therefore the host's fence (no further step), and nothing in the clone confirms it. Also: the shipped launch.launch, the constructor's default (src/environment/ros_social_gym.py:99, 194-200), does not start the simulator; a generated launch file (scripts/create_env_template.py:272-287) or the operator does, so its mode lies outside the package; and reset() retries up to 1000 times with one-second sleeps and steps the simulator inside (ros_social_gym.py:293-330), so an e-stop during a reset stays unconfirmed until it returns. Unblocking needs a reviewed lockstep-fence stop kind with service-mode evidence and a deployment rule, or an upstream stop with a read-back. Only this RESULT.json changed; the fake gate digest is unchanged.
